title: Filtered colimit of etale residue triples
statement: Filtered colimit of etale residue triples.

proof.text: Apply arbitrary-field filteredness to χ = algebraMap κ(p) K, forgetting the separable-closure hypothesis.
Apply the compatible cocone and colimit construction for the ring diagram.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GW and 00D5; combine arbitrary-field filteredness specialized to the prescribed embedding with the compatible colimit construction, by C2 (repair of duplicate filteredness statement).

lean.statement: theorem etaleResidueTriples_filtered_colimit (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra ((Spec R).residueField p) K] [IsSepClosure ((Spec R).residueField p) K] : IsFiltered (EtaleResidueTriples R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K))) ∧ ∃ c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec R).residueField p) K))), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧ ∃ (ρ : R ⟶ c.pt) (ψ : c.pt →+* K), (∀ t, t.α ≫ c.ι.app t = ρ) ∧ (∀ t, ψ.comp (c.ι.app t).hom = ((ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ).hom)
